d: The Celtics defeated the Mavericks, 131-94 tonight in Boston. Jayson Tatum contributed a team-high 32 points to go with 6 rebounds 6 assists and 5 three pointers, with Derrick White of the Celtics adding an additional 16 points (6-11 FG, 4-9 3P) in the game. Zaccharie Risacher finished with a team-high 18 points along with 5 rebounds for the Mavericks in the losing effort. The Celtics improve their record to 11-2 with the win, while the Mavericks fall to 7-7 for the season.
